blocking_condition.reason: For a current Bundesliga assignment, build_player_state requires an evidenced club_valid_from in order to construct a confirmed player_club_assignment and reach SSOT_PROCESSABLE.
blocking_condition.available_full_league_evidence: The immutable full-league roster index proves current roster membership at the captured repository observation state, but explicitly does not establish each player's exact club_valid_from date.
blocking_condition.governance_constraint: DOC-015 requires validity boundaries to reflect actual source precision; an unknown required boundary must not be replaced by an invented season-start or capture date.
blocking_condition.consequence: A new full-league executable materialization-input file cannot yet be produced without fabricating validity values.

required_next_supply.minimum: For each current materializable player, provide or derive from already persisted immutable evidence a defensible club_valid_from consistent with source precision.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not default all players to 2026-08-28.
Do not use roster capture timestamp as a proxy for club_valid_from.
Do not infer transfer dates from names or roster membership alone.
